title: Split the ArchMap sample site by user intent
description: Separate the Next topology showcase, full DSL playground, example gallery, ScreenFlow prototype, and lifecycle preview while sharing one Core bundle and sample registry.
completion_criteria: The root page presents the ArchMap Next boundary-analysis experience.
Playground, gallery, prototype, and lifecycle experiences have stable dedicated URLs.
All pages reuse DEFAULT_ARCHMAP_SAMPLES and the same Core rendering APIs.
The GitHub Pages build publishes and verifies every route.
Focused browser and build checks pass without changing public Core behavior.
evidence: Root, playground, examples, prototype, and lifecycle routes passed in-app browser smoke checks.
Dedicated pages open in Topology, Prototype, and Requirements views respectively.
npm run typecheck, npm test -- --run (327 tests), npm run build, and git diff --check passed.
The Pages assembly contains every route plus ScreenFlow image assets with relative build URLs.
notes: The site shares DEFAULT_ARCHMAP_SAMPLES and Core APIs. Optional icons, lifecycle, and Three.js are loaded only on routes that need them. The existing dev server remains visible on port 5173.
